t: Ectaco - Wikipedia
s: September 13, 2025 - ECTACO was founded in the autumn of 1989 in New York, USA, by David Lubinitsky, who was born in Saint Petersburg, Russia. The company was functioning at that time mainly as a reseller of electronic dictionaries from other manufacturers. In 1990 ECTACO started to develop its hardware and software.
